0022600205.text: The Detroit Pistons host the Washington Wizards with Detroit at 6-2, first in the Central and third in the East, though they are coming off a loss after going 6-2 over their last ten. Washington is 4-6, second in the Southeast and 8th in the East, on a three-game losing streak, and the Pistons are without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while the Wizards are missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Anthony Davis day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 117-95 win in Washington on March 19, 2026.
